text: Basic Information 1.Place of residence and birthplace should include the city name, and the correspondence address should include street number. 2.The contactnumber should follow the structure of country code + area code + phone number. 3.The photo should be in passport size on a white background, without glasses, headscarf, frameworks. 4.All original files need to be kept, including 10 passport-size photos. Other material 1.High school diploma. 2.High school transcript. 3.Passport first page and visa page. 4.The foreign medical examination record issued within 6 months. 5.Proof of no criminal record within 6 months of issuance. 6.Asset certificate issued by the bank (asset proof or 6-month transaction list from banks). 7.Applicant's letter of guarantee must be signed by the applicant.
